visual.summary: A slim spruce fence lamp post on a dark oak foot and a plus-shaped cobblestone stair base, with one arm and a hanging lantern. Reads clearly as a street lamp.
problems: Optional: the post top ends in a bare fence (1,4,1); fine for L1 since L2 caps it with a lantern.
